full_judgment: 3. Respondent No. 1 and auction purchaser respondent No. 4 contested the Rule separately by filing separate affidavits-in-opposition and contending inter alia that presumption of good faith cannot override statutory provisions, that the consignment having not been cleared with the prescribed period auction was validly done under section 82 of the Customs Act, that the petitioner has misconceived the correspondences between the Customs Authority and himself, that the goods are not frustrated cargo within the meaning of section 138 of the Customs Act and that the petitioner has no locus standi to file the writ petition. The petitioner filed affidavit-in-reply. The High Court Division accepted the contentions of respondent Nos. 1 and 4 and discharged the Rule Nisi.
